svg.text: 35 screens. Root stack > Main (drawer) > Tabs. Tab and drawer screens are one tap apart; detail screens push over them and Back returns along the arrow.
Drawn from navigation/navigationMap.js by npm run diagram. Every param is an id.
opens a detail, passes the id shown
log in, sign up, or demo (clears history)
↳ opens ... = a link that jumps to a tab or drawer screen
Owner logs in or signs up, or Demo as Landlord
Tenant logs in or joins, or Demo as Tenant
